desc:
🚲 Welcome to BMX Life, the BMX game on Roblox! Ride real-feel BMX physics, land flips, spins & grinds, chain combos and earn cash for new bikes!

🏙️ Big city map: Old Town streets, office plaza, BETONKA skatepark and the giant MEGA HILL with a mega ramp
🤸 Backflips, frontflips, 360s, wheelies, manuals, stoppies, fakies and rail grinds
💰 Combo = cash: link tricks, nail the PERFECT LANDING and watch the money fly in
🚲 BMX DEPOT: unlock faster bikes that pop higher, then paint them your style
🏆 Climb the RICHEST leaderboard
📻 Built-in radio and first-person camera

📱 Play on PC, phone and tablet

❓ How do I earn money? Do tricks! Longer combos and clean landings pay more.
❓ How do I get a new bike? Visit BMX DEPOT at spawn or tap SHOP to teleport there.

🛠️ The game is in early access and gets new spots and bikes regularly. Found a bug? Let us know!
